propositions: Code-review findings raised on one patchset disappear on the next if not re-emitted, allowing defects to merge uncaught (change 1867 PS1–PS2 finding lost on PS3–PS4).

A new `standing` sub-object on each carried finding tracks origin patchset, prior decision bucket, and lifecycle state (still-present, addressed, withdrawn) to enforce one-shot carry and prevent ratchet.
Carried findings are surfaced-only with non-empty evidence, injected post-Pass-1 into `standing_findings` workflow input, and merged by `merge_findings` only for findings absent from fresh Pass-1.
The posture clamp in `code_review_decide` prevents a carried item from rising above its `origin_decision`, even when criterion or threshold changes between patchsets.

A finding is carried across patchsets only once (`withdrawn` state blocks re-carry), and state is assigned by content-hash matching (REGION_UNCHANGED/REGION_UNKNOWN → still-present, REGION_CHANGED → addressed).
